title: Average and Median Salaries of Early Childhood Educators
what_it_is: Average and Median Salaries of Early Childhood Educators

sections.label: Early childhood educator salaries
sections.summary: ECDA surveys show early childhood educator salaries rose about 15% since 2013, outpacing the general market, with further growth expected.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Based on ECDA's survey which they conducted in 2016, basic salaries for educarers with a professional certificate range from about $1,800 to $2,100 per month, salaries for teachers with a professional teaching Diploma range from $2,200 to $3,000, and salaries for principals with a professional leadership Diploma range from $3,100 to $6,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: These salaries have increased by about 15% since the previous survey in 2013, outpacing that of the general market for similar job sizes which grew by about 8% over the same period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Also, based on the 2017 Polytechnic Graduate Employment Survey, the starting salaries of full-time early childhood Diploma fresh graduates have increased by about 20% to $2,300 since 2013.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Going forward, ECDA expects salary growth for early childhood educators to continue to outpace that of the general market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Apart from the continued expansion of the sector, which will require 20,000 early childhood educators by 2020, from about 17,000 today, ECDA is working closely with anchor as well as partner operators to ensure salary and career progression for their teachers, commensurate with their contributions and professional skills.
